Pima County FYI External Newsletter
 ‌ 
 Welcome to Pima County FYI — the County’s official twice-monthly newsletter. Here you’ll find the latest stories, news releases, and updates on public services, community programs, and events that matter to our residents.
 There's a lot going on every day in Pima County government, and it's important that the public, voters and taxpayers know what their government is up to.
 From free resources and job programs to sustainability efforts and volunteer opportunities, Pima County FYI helps keep you informed and connected. Bookmark this page to stay up to date with what’s happening across our departments.
 Want to get these updates by email? Subscribe to the Pima County FYI Newsletter through GovDelivery.
 Read the  https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/azpima/bulletins/3951f57  latest newsletter for recent updates.
 Have feedback or suggestions? 
 Email us . We'd love to hear from you!
 We hope you enjoy it.
